title: Validate name input in add_name_to_ns() by Barry-Xu-2018 · Pull Request #1281 · ros2/rcl · GitHub
body_rendered_text:
Description


Fixes ros2/ros2#1777


When add_name_to_ns() is called for the first time and the input name is an empty string ("" as a key in YAML), it will be directly added to "ns_tracker->node_ns".  While add_name_to_ns() is called for the second time, cur_ns is from ns_tracker->node_ns (it is an empty string). So ns_len is 0.  sep_len is 1 (fixed value). cur_ns + ns_len - sep_len caused a pointer out-of-bounds error.

So if name is an empty string, it is an invalid parameter.

discussion_rendered_text:
Pull request overview


This PR fixes a pointer out-of-bounds vulnerability in add_name_to_ns() by adding validation to reject empty string names. When an empty string was passed as a name, it would be stored in the namespace tracker, and subsequent calls would perform invalid pointer arithmetic (cur_ns + ns_len - sep_len where ns_len=0 and sep_len=1), resulting in undefined behavior.


Changes:



Added validation to reject empty string names in add_name_to_ns()


Added test coverage for the empty string validation case
